        structure LargeIndecomposable.ClosedZigzagTransfer.TargetPowerAlignedPathData {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Type x} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u, x} C] [CategoryTheory.Preadditive C] [CategoryTheory.Linear k C] {n : ℕ} (D : CategoryTheory.Functor (LinearPathCategory.Category k (ClosedZigzag.Vertex n)ᵒᵖ) C) [D.Additive] [CategoryTheory.Functor.Linear k D] {X Y : LinearPathCategory.Category k (ClosedZigzag.Vertex n)ᵒᵖ} (p : Quiver.Path (LinearPathCategory.vertex Y) (LinearPathCategory.vertex X)) :
        Type u

        Minimal target-oriented alignment output needed from the BGRS power calculation for one landing arrow. The target-radical half of the endpoint layer is automatic from tauData; the remaining source-radical and cross inclusions are the two genuine alignment statements.

        • pi : D.obj X ⟶ D.obj Y

        • degree : ℕ
        • landing_eq : D.map (LinearPathCategory.pathHom p) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp self.pi (self.tau ^ self.degree).asHom
        • landing_exact : D.map (LinearPathCategory.pathHom p) ∉ targetPowerTail self.pi self.tau (self.degree + 1)

        • cross_raises : forbiddenCrossSubmodule D X Y ≤ targetPowerTail self.pi self.tau (self.degree + 1)
